properties.note: FIXED AT THE ROOT the fact named: the schema no longer declares defaults for Verification.method and .level, so the validator has nothing to inject and a check recorded without them stores nothing for them. Fix (1) of the fact's ranked three; fix (3), the setter, shipped in v0.48.0 as the correction tool. Pinned failing-first. BOUNDS: (a) existing Verifications keep whatever value they carry — a node that read `test` yesterday still does, and the setter is how to correct it; (b) DesignEpoch.status still defaults to `arrived` and still injects — deliberately left, its schema argues the case, Anthony did not rule on it; (c) whether 'stored vs read-supplied' was established is now moot — nothing is declared, so nothing is either.
